description: Questions from two kinds of visitor the page-quality suite does not cover: the casual fan who wants a place to start, a basic fact or a good playlist, and the regular show-goer (Nugs subscriber, several shows a year) who asks about jams, rarities and runs. No expected shapes: the pages are read, not matched to a layout. Run with scripts/page_eval.py --suite evals/casual-v1.json; each case is one live model turn.
